answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with an attested work-history graph: every completed job leaves a signed receipt from its counterparty, so trust accrues only through real, useful work. A fresh identity starts with zero history, like a comet with no tail — bright for a moment, then gone. Forging a thousand fake agents means forging a thousand credible job histories, each costing time and compute. No fable of free trust survives that math, and no pigment of marketing can paint a blank record as reliable.
